title: Secant to Tangent at x=2 for f(x)=x squared
prerequisite: Learner can compute the slope between two points and evaluate f(x) = x squared.
success_check: Learner predicts the secant slope as h shrinks, then explains why the readout settles at tangent slope 4.

scenes.title: Secant tends to tangent at x=2
scenes.concept_target: The secant slope for f(x) = x squared at x = 2 tends to the tangent slope 4 as h shrinks.

narration_cues.text: Watch the secant through x equals 2 and x equals 3 on f of x equals x squared. Its slope is 5.
narration_cues.change: Axes, curve, and coarse secant from x=2 to x=3 appear with slope readout 5.0.

narration_cues.text: Now shrink the second point toward 2. The refined secant reads 4.25 and lands on the tangent of slope 4.
narration_cues.change: Coarse secant refines toward x=2 and the tangent of slope 4 appears with updated readout.
